Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Part 370010 – complete package proposal for 2027
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. We propose a complete package at EUR 4.90/kg, payment 14 days net, contract 36 months, with AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Annual quantity is 23,700 kg, delivery DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).
AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

We recognize the annual increases you cited. These recent readings and our actual purchases support reviewing the base together with the faster payment and longer commitment. Our historical framework already had PPI indexation; this proposal defines the new package together.

Please have the authorized pricing committee review these complete terms. What binding package price can you approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

To summarize, our Angebot provides a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: part:370010 – closing proposal EUR 5.00/kg, 14 days, 36 months, AS-14404
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer. We note that you have moved from EUR 6.10 to EUR 5.30/kg and accepted 14-day payment, the 36-month term and the AS-14404 clause.

With AS-14404 indexed on a 45% material share from base month 2026-08, future movements in the alloy cost you cited are passed through in both directions. The base price therefore does not need to carry that material risk as well.

To close this now, we propose the following complete package:
- Unit price EUR 5.00/kg
- Payment 14 days net
- Contract 36 months
- AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- 23,700 kg/year, DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling

If you issue exactly this package as your binding main offer, we can conclude promptly.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: Re: part:370010 – data behind our proposal, EUR 5.00/kg package
move.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for moving from EUR 5.30 to EUR 5.20/kg on the 36-month, 14-day, AS-14404 package.

You asked which figures our position rests on. These are the checked readings from our first email:
AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
The clause uses base month 2026-08. Any AS-14404 movement on the 45% material share after that month is therefore passed through to the price in both directions, with no deadband.

The base price therefore needs to cover the non-material part. The alloy movement is handled by the clause.

Our complete package is unchanged:
- Unit price EUR 5.00/kg
- Payment 14 days net
- Contract 36 months
- AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- 23,700 kg/year, DAP, lead time 14 days, effective 2027-01-01, no tooling

If you issue exactly this package as your binding main offer, we can conclude promptly.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
